game.name: Blossom Tales
game.desc: A top-down action-adventure told as a bedtime story. Grandpa spins Lily a tale about a young knight who must break the sleeping curse the sorcerer Crocus has cast on the king. Explore an open kingdom, clear dungeons, solve puzzles and gather a toybox of classic items, while the narration keeps cheerfully interrupting itself. Hand-drawn pixel art and a design that wears its 16-bit influences proudly.
